ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.title: Service level compliance
ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.description: Clocks met, missed and still open past due, by queue, team, priority, policy or channel; cancellations apart.
ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.basis: Clock start date, as of a time

ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.title: Response times
ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.description: First response and resolution: count, median, p90 and mean in business and elapsed time, and open age.

ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.title: Case volumes
ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.description: Received, resolved, reopened, cancelled and merged cases, assignments and the open backlog.
ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.basis: Received date; backlog as of a time

ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.title: Return analysis
ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.description: Returns by reason, product, response or customer: requested, received, accepted, credited, amounts per currency.

ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.title: CSAT results
ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.description: Feedback answers of one form and period: response rate, score distribution and the answers.

ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.title: Case analytics
ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.description: One case's clocks and events; opened from a case's Service level tab.

ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.title: Online sales
ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.description: Orders, items, gross, discounts, net sales, net invoiced and average order by store, period and currency; top products.

ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.title: Cart recovery
ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.description: Carts opened, abandoned, signed in, recovery sends, delivered, recovered orders and their value, per currency.

ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.title: Promotion use
ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.description: Orders, uses, discount and the net sales of those orders by promotion and code, with the uses left.

ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.title: Channel health
ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.description: Channel messages received, processed, failed and retried, and each feed's last complete build.

ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.title: Balance sheet
ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.description: Assets, liabilities and equity at the end of a period.

ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.title: Income statement
ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.description: Income and expense of a period, to net income.

ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.title: Cash flow
ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.description: Cash from operating, investing and financing activities.

ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.title: Retained earnings
ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.description: Retained earnings at the start, net income, distributions.

ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.title: Financial ratios
ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.description: Liquidity, activity, leverage and profitability ratios.

ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.title: Aging
ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.description: Receivables or payables open on a day, by days past due.

ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.title: Partner ledger
ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.description: Each customer's or supplier's movements and balance on its account.

ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.title: Invoice reconciliation
ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.description: Invoices, payments and postings that disagree with the ledger.

ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.title: Trial balance
ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.description: Each account's beginning balance, debits, credits and ending balance.

ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.title: General ledger
ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.description: The posted lines of each account, with a running balance.

ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.title: Posted amounts
ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.description: Each account's posted debits, credits and balance between two days.

ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.title: Budget variance
ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.description: Each account's budget, commitments, actual and what remains.

ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.title: Stock transactions
ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.description: The receipts, issues and count variances of a period.

ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.title: Inventory valuation
ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.description: Stock value beside the inventory accounts, by product; values need financial read.

ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.title: Sales analysis
ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.description: Ordered, shipped, invoiced and returned, by product, customer or class; margin for a price and cost reader.

ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.title: Sales analysis (finance)
ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.description: Sales' analysis in Accounting: ordered, shipped, invoiced and returned, the cost of what shipped and its margin for a cost reader.

ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.title: Stock at date
ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.description: What was on hand at the end of a past day, with its opening, receipts, issues and adjustments.

ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.title: Operations history
ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.description: Receipts, shipments, returns and transfers with their quantities, dates and days late.

ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.title: Count variance
ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.description: Counted against expected quantities, with the posted variances and reasons.

ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.title: Work order status
ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.description: Target, good and remaining quantity, days late and what blocks each work order.

ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.title: Materials
ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.description: Required, issued, returned and net material, and good and held output, with lots.

ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.title: Operation performance
ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.description: OEE by work center: availability, performance and quality, with downtime by reason.
ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.basis: A period, the last week by default

ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.title: Loss
ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.description: Scrap, process loss and rework against good output; their cost needs financial read.

ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.title: Quality
ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.description: Production inspections: samples, readings, failure rate, holds and time to disposition.

ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.title: Production cost
ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.description: Cost by component, WIP, output allocation and variance of each work order; amounts need financial read.

ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.title: BOM variance
ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.description: Planned against issued material, substitutes, yield and time.

ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.title: Planning
ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.description: Required, available, held, suggested and converted quantities with their provenance.

ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.title: Portfolio
ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.description: Every project's status, health, progress, schedule against the forecast, and hours of budget.

ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.title: Profitability
ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.description: Budget, cost, billable value, billed and margin by project, with totals by client.

ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.title: Progress
ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.description: A project's estimated, actual and remaining work by milestone and down the work item tree.

ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.title: Sprints
ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.description: The velocity of a project's last sprints and a sprint's burndown.

ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.title: Time
ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.description: Hours by project, item, person, work type or client, week by week or by month, with the billable part.

ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.title: Utilization
ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.description: Capacity against the hours logged and billed, by person and week.

ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.title: Work items
ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.description: Open, created, resolved and overdue items, by status, type, assignee or component, and the cycle time.

ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.title: Catalog checks
ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.description: Products missing what they need to sell: prices, categories, images, descriptions and identifiers.

ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.title: Price history
ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.description: Each price's changes and the audit of who changed it, by product, price list and organization.

ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.title: Cost history
ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.description: Standard and estimated costs over time, with their approvals; for cost readers.

ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.title: Cost roll-up
ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.description: How a product's standard cost builds up from its materials, operations and overheads; for cost readers.

ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.title: Supplier scorecards
ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.description: Each supplier's delivery, quality and price results, with the evaluations behind them.

ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.title: Spend
ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.description: Purchase spend by supplier, product or category, per currency.

ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.title: Commitments
ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.description: Ordered, received, accepted and billed quantities of open purchase orders, stage by stage.

ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.title: Procurement tracker
ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.description: Each request through its quote, order, receipt and bill, with the days at each stage.

ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.title: Purchase history
ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.description: What was bought from whom, at what price and when, by product or supplier.

ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.title: Supplier statement
ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.description: A supplier's bills, payments and balance over a period, in its currency.

ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.title: Orders
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.description: Placed sales orders, each counted once, whatever its currency.
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.statusBasis: Placed orders: approved, processing, shipped and completed; not open (draft) or proposed (quote)
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.additiveDimensions: store, channel, customer, product, currency, period
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.allowedDimensions: store, channel, customer, customer class, product, currency, period
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.exclusions: Recurring base orders (orderPurposeEnumId OrpRecurringTemplate) are templates, never orders; their renewals count when placed. Open and proposed orders are not counted.
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.drillContract: The orders of the selected bucket from the sales datasets

ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.title: Order value
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.description: The value of placed sales orders, the sum of their parts' totals, in each order's own currency.
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.statusBasis: Placed orders: approved, processing, shipped and completed; not open (draft) or proposed (quote)
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.numerator: The sum of the parts' totals
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.additiveDimensions: store, channel, customer, product, period (within one currency)
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.allowedDimensions: store, channel, customer, customer class, product, currency, period
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.exclusions: Recurring base orders (orderPurposeEnumId OrpRecurringTemplate) are templates, never orders; their renewals count when placed. Open and proposed orders are not counted.
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.drillContract: The orders of the selected bucket from the sales datasets

ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.title: Invoiced revenue
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.description: Finalized sales invoice amounts by invoice date, net of credit memos, in native currency.
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.statusBasis: Finalized, sent and paid sales invoices
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.numerator: Invoice item amounts, net of credit memos
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.allowedDimensions: customer, customer class, product, store, currency, period
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.exclusions: Draft and cancelled invoices; purchase invoices
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.scopePolicy: The viewer's organizations; Accounting report read

ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.title: Open case backlog
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.description: Cases open at a moment, by queue, team, type or channel.
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.statusBasis: Open: not resolved, closed or cancelled
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.exclusions: Requests without a case extension; merged cases (counted on the case kept)
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.scopePolicy: The viewer's organizations, queues and teams

ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.title: Service level compliance
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.description: Clocks met over the clocks decided and those open past due, in the period.
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.dateBasis: Clock start date, as it stood at the as-of time
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.statusBasis: Met, missed, closed without it, open past due
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.denominator: Clocks decided (met or missed) and open past due
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.allowedDimensions: queue, team, priority band, policy, channel, clock
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.exclusions: Cancelled clocks are apart, never in the rate; a clock a merge ended (its copy on the kept case counts)
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.scopePolicy: The viewer's organizations, queues and teams

ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.title: Quantity on hand
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.description: Physical quantity on hand now, by product, facility, location, lot and owner, in each product's unit.
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.additiveDimensions: facility, location, lot, owner (within one product unit)
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.exclusions: Valuation is Accounting's measure; a current snapshot is not a past one

ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.title: Stock at date
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.description: What was on hand at the end of a past day, from the movements up to it.
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.dateBasis: Effective date of each movement, to the end of the day
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.additiveDimensions: facility, location, lot (within one product unit)

ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.title: Overall equipment effectiveness
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.description: Availability times performance times quality, by work center, over a period.
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.dateBasis: Operation run time in the period
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.numerator: Run time × ideal rate × good output, from the parts
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.additiveDimensions: none (recompute from availability, performance and quality)
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.exclusions: Planned downtime is outside planned production time

ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.title: Utilization
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.description: Hours logged and billed against each person's capacity, week by week.
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.exclusions: A week without capacity is unavailable, not zero
